items.title: Catch up older Replies after reconnecting
items.detail: When the Gateway provides message-sequence summaries, Tuner checks older conversations that changed while disconnected without reloading every conversation. With Tightbeam 0.1.16, it continues checking pending prompts, changed read positions and recent conversations; older Replies may wait for a live update.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Compatible with: Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4304) and Chat v0.1.104. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.
